ops.title: In-process daemonkit fixtures: the control lane is unreachable by design
ops.body:
Constraint every daemonkit-backed test fixture in this repo must design around, established while restoring the cli daemon-socket suite at the v0.21 flag day.

**The wall**: daemonkit's Control attach refuses a pinned PID equal to os.Getpid() (daemonkit control.go:136, godoc at :85 — the anti-self-dial guard), and Client.WaitReady routes through Control (waitready.go:72-77). Therefore **no in-process daemonkit.Serve fixture can satisfy any Control-routed verb** — WaitReady, Control.Health, Control.Drain. This is deliberate daemonkit design, not a gap: the retired pre-v0.21 transport had no such guard, so the old wire fixtures' in-process Control coverage was exercising a shape daemonkit now explicitly forbids.

**What still works in-process**: the Business lane has no self-dial guard — business.go:211 explicitly names 'an in-process test pair' as a supported attach shape. Consumer RPC over the real label-derived socket is fully servable in-process.

**Consequences for fixtures**:
- Readiness must come from a fixture-owned probe op on the Business lane, retried while the daemon refuses (ErrNotReady/ErrAbsent are the transient startup refusals) — never WaitReady.
- Control-routed health in code under test routes through a seam; internal/cli's daemonHealthContext (internal/cli/service.go) is the restored one, stubbed by startDaemonTestServer with the client's own exact-ready validation semantics.
- Sandbox with a SHORT root: os.MkdirTemp("/tmp", "ccp-home") + testhome.Sandbox, never t.TempDir() — macOS caps sun_path at 104 bytes and daemonkit refuses a longer socket path typed (*paths.SocketPathError, paths/socket.go:5).
- Full Control fidelity (pid pinning included) requires a child-process daemon — daemonkit's own e2e shape (internal/e2ehelper re-execs under DAEMONKIT_HOME). That harness is scoped with the poll-machinery E2E in backlog task 05c54e1.

Reference implementations: internal/cli/daemon_test_server_test.go (business-lane daemon fixture) and internal/cli/sync_test.go startCLITestSyncHelper (resident helper via helperruntime).
